name: Regular City Council Meeting Agenda
agenda_text:
PLEASE TAKE NOTICE, this regular meeting of the City Council will be held
  in-person. Members of the public may attend to speak during public comment
  as described below. In order to reduce the risk of spreading coronavirus
  (COVID-19) and pursuant to the Governor’s Executive Orders N-25-20 and N-
  29-20, Public observation and participation will be facilitated by the following
  means:

  Members of the public may observe the meeting via livestream on the City’s
  website at https://artesia.12milesout.com/livevideo. Members of the public may
  view the meeting and provide public comments in-person in the City Council
  Chambers located in Artesia City Hall subject to posted COVID-19 protocols.

  Public  comments  may  also  be  submitted  by  email at
  publiccomments@cityofartesia.us or by leaving a voicemail at (562) 865-6262,
  extension 200. Comment submitted before 4:00 p.m. on the date of the meeting
  will be read until the time limit of three minutes has been reached.

  REGULAR MEETING OF THE ARTESIA CITY COUNCIL

  ALBERT O. LITTLE COMMUNITY CENTER
  18750 CLARKDALE AVENUE
  ARTESIA, CA 90701

  MONDAY, DECEMBER 13, 2021
  7:00 P.M.

CALL TO ORDER

ROLL CALL

INVOCATION – PASTOR ROBIN KIM, ARTESIA-CERRITOS UNITED METHODIST
CHURCH

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE – MISS ARTESIA ROYAL COURT

APPROVAL OF AGENDA

ANNOUNCEMENT REGARDING SPEAKER CARDS AND PUBLIC COMMENTS
This time is for members of the public to address the Councilmembers. Any public
comments that cannot be heard within the next 20 minutes will be heard at the end of the
meeting. Public comments received prior to the commencement of the meeting will be
read at this time. Anyone wishing to speak to the City Council in-person should fill out a
speaker card and give that card to the City Clerk at the staff table prior to the
commencement of the meeting. Please observe a time limit of three (3) minutes when
giving your presentation.

  Page 1 of 2
 COUNCILMEMBER COMMENTS
This is the time for general comments, announcements, and requests of staff and/or
other issues of concern to Councilmembers that may briefly be presented at this time.

CEREMONIAL PRESENTATION

  1. CERTIFICATE OF RECOGNITION TO ERNESTO OLIVARES
  STAFF REPORT  ATTACHMENT

REORGANIZATION PROGRAM

  2. CITY COUNCIL REORGANIZATION SELECTION OF MAYOR

  3. CITY COUNCIL REORGANIZATION SELECTION OF MAYOR PRO TEM

  4. INCOMING MAYOR’S COMMENTS

ADDITIONAL PUBLIC COMMENTS
This time is set-aside for the public to address the City Council on any item of interest
within the subject matter jurisdiction of the City Council that could not be heard under
public comment section at the beginning of the meeting.

ADDITONAL COUNCILMEMBER COMMENTS
This is the time for additional general comment, announcements, and requests of staff
and/or other issues of concern to Councilmembers that may briefly be presented at this
time.

  ADJOURNMENT TO
  ADJOURNED REGULAR CITY COUNCIL MEETING
  OF DECEMBER 15, 2021, AT 7:00 P.M.
The City of Artesia complies with the Americans with Disabilities Act of 1990. If you require special assistance to attend or participate
in this meeting, please call the City Clerk’s office at 562-865-6262 at least 48 hours prior to the meeting. Copies of Staff Reports are
on file in the Office of the City Clerk and are available for inspection. Anyone who requires audio assistance to listen to these
proceedings may request the use of an assistive listening device (ALD) from the City Clerk. If you require said device, please come
forward to the City Clerk at the staff table for assistance.

  Page 2 of 2
minutes_text:
CITY OF ARTESIA
  ALBERT O. LITTLE COMMUNITY CENTER
  18750 CLARKDALE AVENUE, ARTESIA, CA 90701

  REGULAR MEETING OF THE ARTESIA CITY COUNCIL

  MONDAY, DECEMBER 13, 2021
  7:00 P.M.
The Regular Meeting of the Artesia City Council was called to order at 7:19 p.m., on Monday,
December 13, 2020 at the Albert O. Little Community Center. The Invocation was presented by
Linda Gonzalez. The Pledge of Allegiance was led by the Miss Artesia Royal Court.

Present:  Rene Trevino, Mayor
  Melissa Ramoso, Mayor Pro Tem
  Ali Taj, Councilmember
  Tony Lima, Councilmember
  Monica Manalo, Councilmember

Also Present:  Melissa Burke, Acting City Manager
  John Natalizio, Assistant City Attorney
  Ernesto Sanchez, City Clerk

MEETING PROCEDURES

  THE CITY CLERK READ THE MEETING PROCEDURES AS FOLLOWS:

  Members of the public may attend to speak during public comment or on agenda items,
  as described below. In order to reduce the risk of spreading COVID-19) and pursuant to
  the Governor’s Executive Orders, Public observation and participation will be facilitated by
  the following means:

  Members of the public may observe the meeting via livestream on the City’s website.
  Members of the public may view the meeting and provide public comments in-person in
  the City Council Chambers at Artesia City Hall subject to posted COVID-19 protocols.

  Public comments may also be submitted by email at publiccomments@cityofartesia.us or
  by leaving a voicemail at (562) 865-6262, extension 200. Comment submitted before 4:00
  p.m. on the date of the meeting will be read until the time limit of three minutes has been
  reached.

APPROVAL OF AGENDA

  MOTION BY COUNCILMEMBER TAJ TO CONSIDER ITEM NO. 2 AND NO. 3 IN THE
  SAME MOTION AND APPROVE THE AGENDA.

  MOTION SECONDED BY COUNCILMEMBER LIMA.

  Said motion carried (5-0-0-0) in the following roll call vote:

  AYES:  COUNCILMEMBERS:  Manalo, Lima, Taj, Ramoso, Trevino

  1
   NOES:  COUNCILMEMBERS:  None
  ABSTAIN:  COUNCILMEMBERS:  None
  ABSENT:  COUNCILMEMBERS:  None

  CITY COUNCIL ACTION: The Agenda was approved without objection 5-0-0-0.

ANNOUNCEMENT REGARDING SPEAKER CARDS PUBLIC COMMENTS

  The City Clerk presented the Announcement Regarding Public Comments, and reported
  that there were no public comments at this time.

COUNCILMEMBER COMMENTS

  Councilmember Manalo provided comments.

  Councilmember Lima provided comments.

  Councilmember Taj provided comments.

  Mayor Pro Tem Ramoso provided comments.

  Mayor Trevino provided comments.

CEREMONIAL PRESENTATION

  1. CERTIFICATE OF RECOGNITION TO ERNESTO OLIVARES

  Mayor Trevino presented a Certificate of Recognition to Ernesto Olivares for his 40
  years of service to the City of Artesia.

REORGANIZATION PROGRAM

  1. SELECTION OF MAYOR

  2. SELECTION OF MAYOR PRO TEM

  Mayor Trevino opened nomination period for Mayor Elect and Mayor Pro Tem Elect.

  Councilmember Taj nominated Mayor Pro Tem Ramoso for Mayor Elect and
  Councilmember Manalo for Mayor Pro Tem Elect.

  Mayor Trevino closed the nomination period for Mayor Elect and Mayor Pro Tem Elect.

  AYES:  COUNCILMEMBERS:  Manalo, Lima, Ramoso, Taj, Trevino
  NOES:  COUNCILMEMBERS:  None
  ABSTAIN:  COUNCILMEMBERS:  None
  ABSENT:  COUNCILMEMBERS:  None

  CITY COUNCIL ACTION: Mayor Pro Tem Ramoso was elected Mayor and
  Councilmember Manalo was elected Mayor Pro Tem.

  2
   3. INCOMING MAYOR’S COMMENTS

  Mayor Ramoso provided comments.

ADDITIONAL PUBLIC COMMENTS

  There were no additional comments.

COUNCILMEMBER COMMENTS

  Councilmember Trevino provided comments.

  Councilmember Taj provided comments.

  Councilmember Lima provided comments.

  Mayor Pro Tem Manalo provided comments.

  Mayor Ramoso provided comments.

ADJOURNMENT

  Mayor Ramoso adjourned the meeting at 8:01 p.m.
